segments.t: Arriving in the northern town of Bergues, Andrea pays an unexpected visit to Dany Boon's mother, Madame Bonnero. Andrea hopes to preserve the agency's bond with the star, but Madame Bonnero insists on hospitality first. Let's listen to their conversation in French first.
Bonjour, je cherche Madame Bonnero.
Oui, c'est moi, qui êtes-vous?
Je viens vous parler de Dany.
Je ne parle jamais aux journalistes.
Je ne suis pas une journaliste!
Qui êtes-vous alors, jeune femme?
Entrons, je vous explique tout.
Venez dans ma cuisine chaleureuse.
Chez ASK, on connaît bien Dany.
Mathias s'occupait toujours de lui.
Mathias a abandonné le navire.
Prenez le temps et mangez bien.
Je veux bien prendre mon temps.
Alors, qu'est-ce qu'on mange ensemble?
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Bonjour, je cherche Madame Bonnero.
'Hello, I am looking for Madame Bonnero.' Andrea arrives at the front door.
Oui, c'est moi, qui êtes-vous?
'Yes, that is me, who are you?' Madame Bonnero greets the visitor cautiously.
Je viens vous parler de Dany.
'I come to speak with you about Dany.' Andrea states the reason for her trip.
Je ne parle jamais aux journalistes.
'I never talk to journalists.' Madame Bonnero expresses her distrust of the media.
Je ne suis pas une journaliste!
'I am not a journalist!' Andrea clarifies her professional background.
Qui êtes-vous alors, jeune femme?
'Who are you then, young woman?' Madame Bonnero asks for her true identity.
Entrons, je vous explique tout.
'Let's go in, I explain everything.' Andrea suggests talking inside.
Venez dans ma cuisine chaleureuse.
'Come into my warm kitchen.' His mother welcomes them warmly into the kitchen for a meal.
Chez ASK, on connaît bien Dany.
'At ASK, we know Dany well.' Andrea underscores the agency's closeness with the star.
Mathias s'occupait toujours de lui.
'Mathias always took care of him.' Madame Bonnero remembers the former agent fondly.
Mathias a abandonné le navire.
'Mathias abandoned ship.' Andrea uses a vivid metaphor for his sudden departure.
Prenez le temps et mangez bien.
'Take the time and eat well.' Madame Bonnero dispenses motherly wisdom.
Je veux bien prendre mon temps.
'I really want to take my time.' Andrea accepts the pause from agency stress.
Alors, qu'est-ce qu'on mange ensemble?
'So, what do we eat together?' Madame Bonnero prepares a generous northern meal. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Andrea discovers the generous hospitality of Dany Boon's mother in Bergues. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'hello' and 'look for'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
À demain!
